name: github
description: GitHub Actions (also Gitea and Forgejo Actions): reads each stage's workflow runs, their jobs, their JUnit artifacts and the environments' deployments; starts a gated workflow with workflow_dispatch, runs it again for an older commit, and stops a run.

url.help: the address of a Gitea or Forgejo server, such as https://codeberg.org

ref.help: the branch a started workflow runs on

token.help: a fine-grained token: Actions read and write, Deployments read, Contents read
